source_identity_rule: Record exact committed source and executable SHA-256 before execution; no measurements are relabeled after later source edits.
scope: Authenticated TCP-loopback canonical mailbox logical endpoints. Does not qualify native MVM populations, shaped WAN, real WAN, cryptographic certification or energy.

sustained.workload: Persistent stable streams; alternating canonical Call with exact echo and generic Cast with exact receiver readback. Embedded/trailing zero bytes and changing counter.

interference.hot_worker: Pair zero unpaced until first refusal; does not reset service/tracker or raise quotas.
interference.slow_worker: Pair one waits 50 ms after actual request send and before receiver read, outside broker dispatch and inside operation latency; local application stall, not shaped network or kernel send-buffer backpressure.
interference.malformed_worker: Pair two presents one invalid encoded envelope to canonical service admission before each valid operation; malformed bytes remain local and are not included as network traffic.
interference.cancellation: Pair zero registers then cancels one separately identified unsent Call; persistent stream sequence is not consumed. Last pair cancels a blocked terminal transport receive after a 20 ms signal, before a 2 s deadline. These do not claim remote cancellation of admitted application processing.
interference.healthy_workers: Remaining pairs use the same aggregate-ten-operations-per-second allocation divided by pair population.
interference.offered_load_note: Hot work is additional to paced allocation. This profile observes interference and refusal; it does not promise a mutex scheduling fairness guarantee.

recovery.required_failure_phase: caller_observe_admission after receiver accepted request and received receipt frame; no Reply sequence allocated
recovery.resume: Same broker, services, trackers, transports and ordering owners; expire retained state on real clocks, then complete one Call and one Cast exactly.
recovery.safety: Stop and retain failure if saturation occurs in another phase. Never skip an unknown FIFO gap or recreate a stream owner to claim recovery.

portable_functional_smoke.note: Functional portability witness only. Does not alter one-second measurement profile or production defaults.

bounds.control_quotas: Unchanged native-tier capacity limits: host identities65536/control16384, tenant32768/control8192, mailbox32768/control8192, sender16384/control4096.
bounds.measurement_overlap_rule: Fresh process per cell; one active benchmark cell at a time. If other host builds/tests run concurrently, record the shared-host interference and do not claim isolated CPU or latency.
bounds.checkpoint_drops: Count and report; bounded progress-channel loss cannot become omitted successful transfer evidence.

measurement.bytes: Actual canonical encrypted envelopes and stream framing in both directions including readiness/setup; TCP/IP headers and retransmissions excluded.
measurement.cpu: Aggregate process CPU, setup CPU separately, plus worker-thread CPU (both roles and broker actions on that worker, not separated remote endpoint CPU).
measurement.elapsed: Wall-clock completed operation including computation and socket exchange; never add CPU to elapsed.
measurement.memory: Kernel lifetime process high-water RSS; fresh process per cell. Snapshots are post-operation samples, not inflight allocation peaks.
measurement.diagnostics: Capture refusal counter before/after within the same broker dispatch; record only a newly produced local diagnostic. Concurrent global last-refusal snapshots alone are not causal attribution.
measurement.trials: One bounded campaign cell per profile/count; observations, no statistical speedup claim.
measurement.retention: Preserve failed/incomplete attempts and distinguish them from exact completed application exchanges.

gates: Zero mismatched compared payloads; all completed payloads equal exact original bytes and lengths.
Recovery full-cycle wait observed, old tracker transient entries expire, persistent scope/owner state not reset, new Call+Cast complete exactly.
Steady profile all intended operations complete without admission error; report saturation rather than silently lower load or increase quotas.
Interference reports every worker, hot refusal and healthy completions/tail latency; malformed input refused and cancellation terminal.
RSS and FD sample ceilings not exceeded; compact records preserved and no persistent payload stores created.
